reviewCharts.warning: South Carolina review rows use official South Carolina Elections Database precinct presidential rows and President-versus-U.S.-House comparison rows. U.S. House is district-based rather than a single statewide comparison race; duplicate county/precinct keys from district splits are aggregated before comparison, one nonzero presidential row lacks a nonzero House comparison and is kept as vote-share-only, and precinct boundary geometry is not included. Use these rows as advisory screening inputs, not confirmed findings.
